title: Show dispatched evaluation task progress in local dashboard proof
description:
As a dashboard user, I want a dispatched evaluation task to show its real execution state and progress in the local dashboard, so that I can verify the portable command worker experience end to end.

Feature: Local dashboard observes evaluation task execution

Scenario: A feedback evaluation completes successfully
Given the dashboard has created a feedback-evaluation task
And the local dispatcher claims that task
When the worker executes the evaluation
Then the task transitions from pending to running to completed
And task stages report execution progress when the command supports progress tracking
And the local dashboard reflects those updates without manual reload

Scenario: A feedback evaluation fails
Given the dashboard has created a feedback-evaluation task
When the worker cannot execute the evaluation
Then the task becomes failed with its captured error
And the local dashboard reflects the failure without manual reload

Out of scope: changing the established model in which the evaluation command creates its evaluation record and links it to the dispatched task.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Acceptance proof completed through the local dashboard and dispatcher. The local transport observed task and stage updates, and the feedback evaluation completed successfully.
